profile.headline: Senior software engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Student attending the Jeffrey S. Raikes School of Computer Science and Management at the University of Nebraska - Lincoln, entering his senior year as a computer science major. Pursuing a career as a software developer.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Added support for serving Microsoft Teams team and channel suggestions through an existing internal auto-suggestions API used by Office 365 apps (Teams, Outlook, etc)
• Lead communications with managers of the Teams and Cortana teams about the design of public data schemas for team and channel suggestions 
• Converted an internal bot’s responses to user-friendly adaptive cards during the company hackathon

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on student-led team to create a Crash Intersection Diagrammer for the Nebraska Department of Transportation Highway Safety team
• Designed and implemented an algorithm for contextualizing line segments defining an intersection, as well as an algorithm for placing recorded crashes inside the roads of a contextualized intersection

Tech Used: JavaScript, C#, ASP.NET, REST API

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Mentoring students enrolled in an honors Algorithms and Data Structures class through weekly office hours
• Grading student code using asymptotic run-time and space efficiency as primary metrics for evaluating algorithms
• Covered topics include: Big O notation, classifications of algorithms (greedy, divide-and-conquer, etc.), and solving famous algorithmic problems (Traveling Salesman, Knapsack, etc.)

Tech Used: JavaScript, QUnit

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Worked over 50 hours a week with a team of full time developers in an Agile environment
• Upgraded a system’s inline messaging client to be real-time through the SignalR library, enabling account managers to discuss order details instantly
• Added audit trails of mutable documents by implementing the event sourcing design pattern, creating a perfect record of the document's history
• Implemented an algorithm for automatically generating price updates for thousands of items listed on Amazon, strategically pricing the item to capture the buy box and increase sales
• Tech Used: C#, React/Redux, ASP.NET Core, SignalR

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Mentored honors freshmen in Computer Science I & II, involving the C/Java languages and concepts such as OOP, data structures, searching/sorting algorithms, and discrete math topics (graphs, sets) 
• Tech Used: Java, C

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an internal tool for linking customer feedback with features in development, notifying a customer when a feature they requested has been implemented 
• Modularized Buildertrend’s main page by converting the front end into a collection of Knockout components that were reused throughout the site 
• Tech Used: C#, .NET, JavaScript, Knockout

positions.title: Design Studio Intern
positions.description:
• Adapted a senior capstone project's Xamarin app for iOS by implementing pages requiring iOS camera access and navigation
• Tech Used: C#, Xamarin, Xamarin Forms
